data.description: If a bythos strikes a living target with two slam attacks in a single round, the bythos ages the creature, causing it to advance to the next age category (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 169) if it fails a %1 DC Fortitude save. The victim gains all of the penalties from this aging and none of the bonuses. A venerable victim targeted by this ability dies if it fails the save. This process is reversible with greater restoration, limited wish, miracle, or wish.
data.name: Aging Strike
